description: This file contains an implementation of the UserDao interface, providing database access methods for User entities such as findUser and removeUser, using Spring's JdbcTemplate. It also includes a not-yet-implemented saveUser method.

classes.name: UserDaoImpl
classes.description: The implementation class for the UserDao interface, responsible for user persistence operations using JDBC.

methods.name: findUser
methods.description: Retrieves a User object based on userId from the database using a SQL query.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Placeholder method for saving a User, currently throws a RuntimeException indicating it's not implemented.

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Deletes a User from the database based on userId.
